Get glm

Source: R/utils-glm.R
get_glm.Rd

Get glm output for given link function

Usage

get_glm(formula_string, data, linkfunc)

Arguments

formula_string

A string.

data

Data to use.

linkfunc

Link function. Default is "power5". Can be one of "log", "sqrt", or "identity".
